source_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 over sorted tracked Rust/Cargo paths and embedded installer/src/source_acquire.py, each path + NUL + file bytes; missing files marked MISSING
command: umask 077; LLVM_COV=/usr/bin/llvm-cov LLVM_PROFDATA=/usr/bin/llvm-profdata CARGO_LLVM_COV_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target cargo llvm-cov --workspace --locked --no-clean --no-fail-fast --html --output-dir target/coverage-report -j 8 > target/coverage-report/run.log 2>&1

exclusions: Dependency and test source per standard cargo-llvm-cov exclusions
notes: Full workspace default-feature Rust tests with owner-only umask; isolated worktree target avoids mixed instrumented binaries. First attempt under default umask failed private-storage fixtures; final independent measurement cleared raw profiles and reused compiled artifacts.
